question: Our repo's `.doc-detective.json` has `"autoRecord": true`, and local runs give us a video per context. When Doc Detective Online runs the same repo as a hosted run, there are no videos at all. Is recording just not supported in hosted runs? How do I get the videos there?

facts.text: Hosted runs set `autoRecord` (and `autoScreenshot`) to `false` at the config level, overriding the value in the repository's config.
Setting `autoRecord: true` in a spec or a test turns automatic recording back on in hosted runs, because the test and spec levels override the config level.
Explicit `record` steps are unaffected and still record in hosted runs.

must_not: Hosted runs can't record video at all.
Setting `autoRecord: true` in the repository config, or passing `--auto-record`, turns automatic recording on in hosted runs.

wrong.answer: Hosted runs execute in a sandbox with no screen-capture support, so Doc Detective Online can't record video. Run the specs locally or in your own CI with `--auto-record` when you need videos.

wrong.why: misses the spec and test override
wrong.answer: Doc Detective Online turns automatic recording off for hosted runs. Add `record` and `stopRecord` steps to the tests you want on video.
